plugins.name: pmm-positioning
plugins.description: Build positioning and messaging that actually lands. Define your ideal customer, map the competitive landscape, keep your team's story consistent everywhere it's told, and back every claim with a sourced, gated proof point.

skills.name: alternatives-map
skills.description: Synthesizes research data — win/loss notes, sales call transcripts, G2/Capterra reviews, analyst reports — into a named alternatives map across four buyer-real types (direct competitors, adjacent tools, DIY, and status quo), each with why-chosen, why-left, and unclaimed territory, then deepens brain Section 3 in place. Trigger with "map our alternatives", "who do we actually compete with", "status quo analysis", "our alternatives section is just a competitor list", or any request to identify, evidence, or sharpen who buyers compare you to.
headings: Step 1 — Gather Across All Four Alternative Types
Step 2 — Map Each Alternative Across Its Layers
skills.description_zh: 综合输赢记录、销售通话、G2/Capterra评价及分析师报告，梳理直接竞争者、邻近工具、自建及维持现状四类买方替代方案，说明选择与离开原因和未占领空间，并深化知识库第3节。

skills.name: brand-voice
skills.description: Builds a persona-adaptive Voice & Tone guide — brand attributes, tone shifts by buyer type and channel, forbidden language — then deepens brain Section 4 in place. Trigger with "how should we sound", "voice guide", "our copy feels off", "we sound like everyone else", "adapt tone for", or any request to define, apply, or audit how the brand communicates.
skills.description_zh: 建立能随买方角色和渠道调整的品牌语气指南，定义品牌属性、语气变化及禁用措辞，并深化知识库第4节；用于制定、应用或审查品牌表达。

skills.name: buyer-personas
skills.description: Maps the enterprise buying committee — Economic Buyer, Champion, Technical Evaluator, End User, Procurement — before writing a single message, then builds Dunford-structured, alternatives-anchored personas ready for positioning-messaging. Trigger with "map our buying committee", "who do we need to win over", "build our buyer personas", "who kills our deals", or any request to identify or profile the people involved in a B2B purchase.
headings: Gains (what winning looks like for them personally)
skills.description_zh: 先梳理企业购买委员会中的经济决策者、内部推动者、技术评估者、最终用户和采购角色，再按Dunford结构构建基于替代方案的买方画像，为定位与传播准备。

skills.name: ideal-customer-profile
skills.description: Synthesizes research data — surveys, interviews, usage data, win/loss notes — into an Ideal Customer Profile across demographics, behaviors, Jobs to Be Done, and needs, then deepens brain Section 2 in place. Trigger with "build my ICP", "who is my ideal customer", "analyze our PMF survey", "define our target customer", or any request to identify, segment, or profile customers from research data.
headings: Step 1 — Gather and Segment by Value
skills.description_zh: 综合问卷、访谈、使用数据和输赢记录，按人口特征、行为、待完成任务及需求建立理想客户画像，深化知识库第2节，用于研究数据中的客户识别和分群。

skills.name: market-context
skills.description: Builds the "why now" layer — market maturity, macro forces, buying triggers, narrative arc, and category moment — then deepens brain Section 5 in place. Trigger with "why now", "what's our market context", "define our category", "market narrative", "what macro trends support us", "buying triggers", or any request to define, update, or audit the market forces that make your positioning credible.
skills.description_zh: 建立定位的市场背景及为何现在层面，分析市场成熟度、宏观力量、购买触发因素、叙事和品类时机，并深化知识库第5节。

skills.name: message-house
skills.description: Turns your existing positioning into one clean table: your core story at the top, your 3 supporting reasons to believe it below. Use when someone asks to "build a message house," "put our messaging in a message house," or wants positioning laid out as one scannable page.
skills.description_zh: 把已有定位整理为一页可扫读的消息屋表格，顶部为核心故事，下方为三个支持其可信度的理由。

skills.name: positioning-messaging
skills.description: Builds or audits positioning statements, messaging hierarchies, homepage copy, and persona cards using April Dunford's Obviously Awesome framework across five modes (build, audit, fletch, sales-enablement, homepage). Refuses to generate without a named primary persona and 3+ alternatives including status quo, and blocks output until a 7-point verification gate passes.
skills.description_zh: 依据 April Dunford 的 Obviously Awesome框架创建或审查定位声明、传播层级、首页文案和角色卡，覆盖build、audit、fletch、销售赋能及首页模式；原说明要求明确主画像及至少三种含维持现状的替代方案，并通过七项验证才输出。

skills.name: proof-points
skills.description: Build and maintain a sourced, gated registry of the proof points your messaging relies on — metrics, customer quotes, case study results, and analyst citations. Use when pulling proof points out of a deck or battlecard, checking whether a stat is safe to use in copy, sourcing a new claim before it ships, or auditing an existing set of claims for anything unsourced, stale, or unapproved.
headings: Step 2 — Extract Mode: Mine Claims from Source Material
Step 3 — Add Mode: Register a New Claim Directly
Step 4 — Verify Mode: Check a Claim Before It Ships
Step 5 — Audit Mode: Review the Existing Registry
skills.description_zh: 建立并维护传播主张的证据登记，记录来源和使用门槛，覆盖指标、客户引语、案例结果及分析师引用；用于抽取证明点、判断文案统计能否使用，或排查无来源、过时和未批准的主张。
